verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships GBNF grammar support documented in its own repo, which is used to constrain model output to structured formats (including JSON) via the CLI and server API. There's no independent hands-on confirmation specifically of grammar-based JSON constraining in the evidence pack beyond the first-party doc pointer. missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of grammar usage, documentation of JSON-schema-to-grammar tooling, server API examples showing grammar parameter in requests.
